title: Pandemic
components: 7 Role cards with matching player pawns
96 Disease cubes (24 in each of 4 colors)
59 Player cards (City cards, Special Events, Epidemics)
setup: Place the board with the Outbreaks marker on 0, Infection Rate on 2, and 1 Research Station in Atlanta.
Infect starting cities: Draw 3 Infection cards and place 3 cubes on each; draw 3 more for 2 cubes each; draw 3 more for 1 cube each.
Deal random Role cards and reference sheets to each player; place all pawns in Atlanta.
Deal starting hands: 4 cards each (2-player), 3 cards each (3-player), or 2 cards each (4-player).
Divide remaining Player cards into 4–6 equal piles, shuffle 1 Epidemic card into each pile, and stack them to create the draw deck.
procedure: On your turn, execute the following 3 phases in exact order:
• Movement: Drive/Ferry (adjacent city), Direct Flight (discard destination card), Charter Flight (discard current city card to fly anywhere), Shuttle Flight (travel between two research stations).
• Treat Disease: Remove 1 cube from your current city (or all cubes of that color if the cure has been discovered).
• Share Knowledge: Give or take the City card matching your current city to/from an ally in the same location.
• Build Research Station: Discard the City card matching your current city to place a station.
• Discover a Cure: At any research station, discard 5 City cards of the same color to cure that disease.

Phase 2 - Draw 2 Player Cards: Add to hand. If an Epidemic card is drawn, immediately resolve: Increase infection rate, Infect bottom card of infection deck with 3 cubes, Intensify by shuffling the infection discard pile back on TOP of the deck.
Phase 3 - Infect Cities: Flip cards from the top of the infection deck equal to the current Infection Rate marker; place 1 cube on each city.
endGame: Victory Condition: Discover cures for all 4 diseases immediately (eradication is not required).
Defeat Condition 1: The Outbreaks marker reaches the 8th space on the track.
Defeat Condition 2: You need to place disease cubes of a color on the board, but none are left in the supply.
Defeat Condition 3: A player needs to draw cards from the Player deck, but the deck has run out.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: Cooperative game (collective victory or loss).
notes: Outbreak Chain Reaction: If a city already has 3 cubes of a color and must take another, an Outbreak occurs: advance the Outbreak track by 1 and place 1 cube on every adjacent connected city.
Hand Limit: Players must maintain a strict maximum hand limit of 7 cards at all times (discard or play event cards if over limit).

Eradication: If a cured disease has all cubes cleared completely from the board, flip its cure vial to the sunset/eradicated side—no further cubes of that color can be placed for the rest of the game.
